name: bld6_nat_pow_lt_pow_swap
statement: (m n : ℕ) (hm : 3 ≤ m) (hmn : m < n) : n ^ m < m ^ n
closed: ∀ (m n : ℕ) (hm : 3 ≤ m) (hmn : m < n), n ^ m < m ^ n
informal: Uses Mathlib2.calc_rpow_lt_rpow_swap_of_exp_le: apply it with x = m, y = n; the hypothesis e ≤ m follows from Real.exp_one_lt_d9 (e < 3 ≤ m); then convert rpow with natural exponents to Nat powers (Real.rpow_natCast, Nat.cast_lt).
type: ∀ (m n : ℕ), 3 ≤ m → m < n → n ^ m < m ^ n
